versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Compares the current Git branch to master/main to identify newly added or changed code paths.
- Produces simulated unit-test-style case tables (inputs & expected results) for code changes, without generating test code.
- Analyzes logic, boundary, and exception scenarios for affected units.
- Designed for use with user requests about simulated unit testing or diff result tables (in Chinese by default).
- Outputs tables covering method/branch, simulated inputs, dependencies, expected result, result type, covered code, and notes.
